changes.detail: Pause hidden viewers and retry transient network errors instead of immediately invalidating the session. Reuse only the in-memory authenticated session within a two-minute limit.
Foreground sharing no longer stops merely because the task is removed; Stop and Android capture revocation remain effective. Preserve viewer role/address and show a capture-ended reason.
Native and viewer regression tests for pause, resume, pending approval, expiry and no remote input while paused.

summary: Build 13 prepares an embedded viewer, a two-minute resume window, saved viewer mode/address, and foreground sharing independent of the task screen.

validation.detail: Tests, native build and physical Home/app-switch acceptance pending. No production deployment authorized or attempted for this build.
